facts.text: The resort sits on more than 500 acres of natural landscapes, lakes and a working farm.
facts.excerpt: Nestled amidst over 500 acres of pristine natural landscapes, tranquil lakes, and a thriving farm

facts.text: The resort has an 18-hole golf course designed by two-time British Open champion Greg Norman.
facts.excerpt: 18-hole golf course designed by two-time British Open champion Greg Norman

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Golf Club hosts the PNC Championship.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton Golf Club hosts the PNC Championship

facts.text: The golf course is certified as an Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary.
facts.excerpt: Certified as Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary and endorsed by United States Golf Association

facts.text: Signature spa therapies use honey from the resort's resident bees, citrus from local orchards and other homegrown ingredients.
facts.excerpt: honey from its resident bees, citrus from local orchards, and other homegrown ingredients

facts.text: The spa has an outdoor lap pool and a spa café called Vitale.
facts.excerpt: relax in the outdoor lap pool or enjoy a healthy meal at Vitale, our Orlando spa café

facts.text: Knife & Spoon is the resort's signature steakhouse, led by Chef John Tesar.
facts.excerpt: Proudly recognized as MICHELIN-recommended, our signature steakhouse in Orlando was conceived and led by award-winning Chef John Tesar.

facts.text: Highball & Harvest serves modern Southern food and cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Highball & Harvest offers modern Southern fare and truly inspired cocktails

facts.text: The resort's restaurants source produce, herbs and other ingredients from its garden, apiaries and chicken coops.
facts.excerpt: The garden, apiaries, and chicken coops are not simply for show; the restaurants at The Ritz-Carlton Orlando, Grande Lakes source produce, herbs, and other ingredients

facts.text: The Grande Lakes Waterpark has waterslides, a lazy river, lagoons and a VIP firepit lounge.
facts.excerpt: The new Grande Lakes Waterpark features exciting waterslides, a lazy river, serene lagoons, and a VIP firepit lounge.

facts.text: Guests can take a guided Shingle Creek eco-tour by kayak or canoe toward the headwaters of the Everglades.
facts.excerpt: Continue with a two-hour Shingle Creek Eco-Tour by kayak or canoe, paddling serene waterways to the headwaters of the Everglades.

facts.text: The resort offers falconry experiences, sunrise safari expeditions and fishing excursions on its lake.
facts.excerpt: unique falconry experiences, sunrise safari expeditions, and fishing excursions on our spectacular lake

facts.text: The Space Exploration Experience flies guests by private helicopter to NASA's Kennedy Space Center for a VIP guided tour.
facts.excerpt: Lift off by private helicopter to NASA's Kennedy Space Center for a VIP guided tour.

facts.text: Club Lounge guests receive complimentary food and beverage presentations five times a day.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy complimentary food and beverage presentations five times a day at our hotel club lounge in Orlando.

facts.text: Club Lounge access requires a Club booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.

facts.text: Hotel guests can use the adult-only spa lap pool only with a Spa Day Pass or a spa treatment.
facts.excerpt: Hotel guests may enjoy our adult-only, outdoor, heated lap pool at The Ritz-Carlton Spa with the purchase of a Spa Day Pass or Spa Treatment.

facts.text: Pool cabanas are for overnight resort guests and Ritz-Carlton Club Members only.
facts.excerpt: Cabanas are a resort amenity for overnight resort guests and Ritz-Carlton Club Members only.

facts.text: Ritz Kids entertains young guests with storytelling, animal care lessons, arts and crafts and physical activities.
facts.excerpt: Ritz Kids keeps young guests entertained with storytelling, animal care lessons, arts and crafts, physical activities, and more.

facts.text: The resort is near International Drive.
facts.excerpt: Find your adventure at our luxury resort near International Drive.
